trial_method.candidate_construction: B2 exact T061 bytes; F2/G3/shared byte-identical v3 copies frozen at candidate_freeze_sha
trial_method.third_repetition_rule: After two valid repetitions for the same case/candidate pair, execute exactly one third valid repetition when any frozen discrete field or observed_context_bytes differs, unless a mandatory any-occurrence condition has already made candidate qualification impossible. No fourth repetition.

case_aggregation_rule.activated_entrypoints: element-wise majority over host-observed candidate-body activations
case_aggregation_rule.granted_capabilities: element-wise majority; critical forbidden-grant gates inspect every valid repetition
case_aggregation_rule.permission_broadening: majority; critical ambiguous broadening gates inspect every valid repetition

trial_method.critical_any_occurrence_rule: Any valid repetition with a cross-profile forbidden grant/performance, ambiguous permission broadening, or incorrect semantic outcome on cross-profile/ambiguous cases disqualifies the candidate immediately.
trial_method.early_stop_policy: Stop future candidate observations whenever exact optimistic-completion futility proves qualification or material challenger status impossible.
trial_method.attempt_isolation: Every attempt uses a fresh Codex thread and disposable workspace under the frozen native-Windows host profile.
trial_method.model_attempt_failure_rule: A non-capacity timeout, malformed result or execution failure consumes an attempt; first valid structured observation satisfies the scheduled repetition.
trial_method.external_capacity_event_rule: Explicit provider/account capacity failure is not a model attempt and pauses new scheduling.
trial_method.pause_resume_rule: Resume only under identical v13 frozen asset hashes, runner identity, Codex version, host profile, model/effort, observation uniqueness and stage state.
trial_method.terminal_failure_rule: If both permitted non-capacity attempts fail for a scheduled repetition, stop BLOCKED.

windows_backend_resolution.no_model_call_failure_rule: If Codex CLI 0.149.0 cannot realize a permitted native Windows backend with user config ignored, stop before synthetic or acceptance calls.

windows_workspace_acl.outer_parent: OS temporary parent or another neutral disposable Windows parent permitted by the frozen isolation rules
windows_workspace_acl.required_acl_semantics: ordinary inherited Windows ACL semantics compatible with the selected Codex sandbox token
windows_workspace_acl.terminal_failure_rule: If no permitted native-backend/logical-sandbox profile has a readable workspace, stop before any synthetic or acceptance model call.

host_capability_preflight.failure_rule: If no permitted complete profile passes the unchanged Skill canary reproducibly, stop before any acceptance prompt.

scheduling.reference_stage_gate: B2 must qualify in v13 before F2/G3 are scheduled

stage6_gate.required_live_cell: Codex / native Windows / GPT-5.6 Sol / Medium
